r=pathlib.Path('products/sites/ghost-import-diagnostic'); p=r/'package'; dest=pathlib.Path('products/reviews/ghost-diagnostic-independent.json'); dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def run(args):
 x=subprocess.run(args,cwd=p,text=True,capture_output=True); return {'exit':x.returncode,'stdout':x.stdout,'stderr':x.stderr}

out={'stub_run':tests,'default_run':default,'integrity':checks,'whitespace_probe':{'repr':repr(ws),'contains_newline':chr(10) in ws,'contains_literal_backslash_n':chr(92)+'n' in ws}}
